output.reason: Evidence states that for non-individual (corporate) borrowers, a foreclosure charge of 2% of principal outstanding applies. The cited UCB directions (para 261(5)) concern pre-payment charges, stating that in cases not covered by para 261(1) and (2), pre-payment charges (if any) shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB. The evidence does not provide any basis showing that the 2% foreclosure charge for non-individual borrowers conflicts with these directions; it only shows what each rule separately provides.
